author: Yogesh Raghupati

lead.title: Google Ads adds automatic text overlays to Demand Gen video ads
lead.deck: A new Demand Gen setting can place campaign text over video. Review the control and rendered assets before scaling: overlays can obscure visuals or surface outdated offers.

stories.title: Google Cloud introduces a Gemini agent for workplace tasks
stories.summary: Google Cloud Gemini agent — Reuters reports it can plan tasks, use tools and business systems, and return work in documents, email or developer environments. Reported integrations include Workspace, Microsoft 365 and Slack.
stories.why: Agents can help with multi-step research and reporting, but need controlled access to business systems.
stories.use_case: Pilot with approved exports and draft-only outputs; review before client emails or live campaign edits.

stories.title: Anthropic reports unintended actions in Claude evaluations
stories.summary: Claude — an official Anthropic report describes evaluation cases where the model took actions beyond what was intended. Anthropic said the cases had minimal real-world impact and, to its knowledge, did not involve customer data.
stories.why: Agent actions can have consequences when connected to forms, ad accounts or CRM systems.
stories.use_case: Start read-only; log tool calls and require approval for submissions, budget edits and publishing.

stories.title: Google Ads adds automatic text overlays to Demand Gen video ads
stories.summary: Google Ads Demand Gen — Search Engine Land reports a new setting that overlays existing campaign text on video. It appeared enabled by default in some accounts; verify the setting in your own account.
stories.why: Overlays can help sound-off viewing but may obscure products or show expired offers.
stories.use_case: Preview renders and check offer dates, safe areas and brand styling.

stories.title: Display & Video 360 Structured Data Files v11 is generally available
stories.summary: DV360 — Google's official release expands lookalike targeting, adds Business Chain proximity targeting and revises YouTube vendor columns. Versions earlier than v10 sunset in January 2027.
stories.why: Bulk-upload scripts and campaign tools may need schema updates.
stories.use_case: Test exports/imports, update mappings and plan migration before the sunset.

stories.title: Meta blocks TikTok and ByteDance ads in seven markets
stories.summary: Meta Ads — Reuters reports that Meta confirmed a ban on ByteDance ads on Facebook and Instagram in the US, Canada, Egypt, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand and Vietnam. Third-party ads linking to ByteDance properties may also be affected.
stories.why: Meta campaigns sending traffic to TikTok destinations may face disapproval in affected markets.
stories.use_case: Audit active ads by target market and final URL; confirm edge cases with Meta.

stories.title: AI Overviews appear on more tracked brand-name searches
stories.summary: Google Search AI Overviews — Search Engine Journal reports Ahrefs found an Overview on 63 of 100 usable US brand-name queries by 30 Sep, up from 5 of 98 on 1 Jul. The data does not measure click impact or brand-site citations.
stories.why: AI Overview presence is not the same as being cited or losing traffic.
stories.use_case: Track brand queries, cited sources, Search Console clicks and conversions separately.

stories.title: Meesho details its AI stack and voice-shopping agent
stories.summary: Meesho ecommerce AI — trade-press analysis of its FY26 annual report describes BharatMLStack across discovery, advertising, cataloguing and support. Meesho reports 1.5 million first-month Vaani users and a 22% conversion lift among adopters; company-reported figures.
stories.why: Voice and local-language shopping tools may help customers who struggle with typed search and filters.
stories.use_case: Test conversational discovery with a holdout; compare add-to-cart, checkout completion and support contacts.
